scope: Skill behaviour on the bundled synthetic two-column fixture (examples/sample_two_column.pdf). Not a benchmark result on the platform's fixed scientific cases.

deviations_from_paper.note: 8 of 8 ground-truth sections recovered, in order, including '1.1 Problem setting' and '3.1 Residual error'. Evidence: execution/results/metrics.json -> section_recall, section_order_correct.
The ruled 4x4 table is recovered with rows=4, cols=4 and its header row ['System','E_bind','Error','Runs']; the two-column running text above it is correctly rejected as a table.
Equations (1) and (2) are captured with their numbers; citations containing '=' and digits are not misreported as equations.
The paragraph that starts at the foot of the left column and continues at the head of the right column is rejoined into one paragraph; the join is recorded in changes.
Every paragraph, table and formula carries both a page number and a p07-b012 style block id.
Both running headers and both page-number footers are classified as header_footer and appear in no paragraph. Metric is a leak count, so 0 is correct.
A 22-page Chinese tutorial PDF parses without error (68 headings, 45 paragraphs, 18 captions, 0 missing pages). Its page layout is not ground-truthed here, so this records robustness, not accuracy.

empirical_envelope.verified_on: a two-page two-column fixture with a spanning title/abstract, one continued paragraph, one ruled table, two numbered equations, running headers and footers
untested_here: scanned pages without a text layer
tables with merged cells, multi-row headers, or continuation across a page break

failure_modes.mode: A page has no text layer (scanned document)
failure_modes.impact: That page's content is absent from every output list; status becomes 'partial' and the page is listed under result.missing with handling 'reported, not guessed'.

failure_modes.mode: Two unrelated paragraphs share a region and the first lacks terminal punctuation
failure_modes.impact: A false continuation merge. The join is always written to 'changes', so the merge is auditable, but the paragraph boundary would be wrong.

failure_modes.mode: A table has no repeated column alignment (merged cells, multi-row header)
failure_modes.impact: Rows or columns are under-counted, or the region is not reported as a table at all. Cell contents that cannot be attributed are left empty rather than guessed.

failure_modes.mode: Only a coordinate-free backend (pypdf) is available
failure_modes.impact: Column order and block geometry become unreliable; the run records an explicit uncertainty item instead of silently returning plausible-looking wrong order.
Gap-based column and heading heuristics weaken; heading detection becomes looser and may over-detect sections.

failure_modes.mode: A paragraph continues across a page break
failure_modes.impact: Rejoined only when the punctuation/case heuristic fires; otherwise it stays as two paragraphs, which is visible in the output rather than hidden.
